Karnataka Teachers Protest Non-Academic Duties

Teachers in Karnataka have petitioned the state government to be relieved of non-academic responsibilities, stating they are being treated "like clerks." The issue highlights the significant amount of administrative and other non-teaching tasks assigned to educators. The coverage indicates this is a widespread concern among teachers in the state, impacting their primary role of instruction.
